page.overview:
Who is Bodyguard?

The three main traits of a are related to their continent of work, their size class and their behaviour. Salon-hired cannot travel between continents and are instead bound to the continent in which they are hired. If travels to another continent, his will not meet him there and he may decide to hire one of the local for help - at the cost of the contract on the other continent. If no other is hired though, the old one will loyally await their employer's return to their continent. Each continent has the same set of nine types, with power levels appropriate for that continent. The nine types are composed of three behavior patterns among three size classes. The size class's immediate use is the ease with which are destroyed. Small-sized need more healing and take longer to destroy an enemy whereas large can handle nearly any battle with ease. The size classes come with a secondary function, a so-called "special ability". In , some are out of reach because they lie deep in a small hole, or are located behind a locked door or are obstructed by a large boulder. Small can crawl into holes to fetch the treasure, medium are skilled lock-pickers and large have the strength required to lift the boulder out of the way. Behavior is what sets the members of one size class apart. There are passive who will not engage in battle alone unless forced to, often ignoring a direct command to attack. Aggressive in turn attack everything in sight, whether they can defeat it or not and whether it ruins the chances of getting multiple enemies in one fight or not. Generally the most useful, and therefore most expensive in a given size class, are the assertive ones, who only engage in battle if ordered or if their employer is in trouble.

There are three Drifter can employ in : , and . They work very differently from the normal , being easier to handle in some regards and more difficult in others. They work without a license, so they cannot be hired in the . Instead, must stumble upon them by chance, at first to win their respect, then later to actually hire them. They are significantly more powerful than regular and are capable of trademark moves during battle. Not being bound to a Salon also means they can travel with their employer across continents. However, Drifter do not take when injured and refuse to re-sign a contract when they have collapsed, leaving the length of their use limited. To re-hire them, must seek them out once more.

Throughout the game, there are several compulsory contracts that need to be made in order for the storyline progress. These contracts are always temporary, and dissolve once a particular task has been achieved. These , with the exception of , are unofficial and will not be added to the list in 's notebook. They cannot be taken far from where they were first engaged.
